name: Raydium (AMM v4, CLMM, CPMM)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: The three programs share one 3-of-4 Squads v4 upgrade multisig with no delay. A separate hardcoded admin key resolves to an older 2-of-3 Squads v3 multisig that still sets fees and pool status.
narrative.tag: config admin weaker than the upgrade path
narrative.detail: The upgrade authority is one Squads v4 vault, 3-of-4, no time lock, shared by AMM v4, CLMM and CPMM and re-checked per program each run. The admin key is a constant compiled into all three programs, read live from CLMM's on-chain IDL. It can set fee rates, reassign fee owners, pause pools and, on CLMM, transfer reward ownership. It resolves to the Squads v3 multisig that held the upgrade authority until a 2026-04-22 rotation, retired for code upgrades but never rotated for this role. LaunchLab was not re-checked. DefiLlama listed over $1.0B for raydium-amm on 2026-09-17, split by program not verified.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Admin power is not a bare key
main_gap.reason: One key, or a tiny group, can change it

independent_read.path: program -> ProgramData HzD2cC… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly) -> Squads v4 vault 0 of multisig tr8rgazUrZzgdkfc6Q622nVJHMMzh29trdBE2uBHb4u
independent_read.posture: admin: Squads 3-of-4 of 4 plain keys; delay: none
